# Superpowers

For every software-development task, use the current **obra/superpowers** workflow from https://github.com/obra/superpowers.

Before responding or acting, read the current `skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md`, then load and follow every relevant current Superpowers skill. Prefer a native installed Superpowers plugin/skill mechanism when the harness provides one. Never substitute a remembered copy for the current skill.

Direct user instructions and `AGENTS.md` take precedence. Otherwise follow Superpowers' process rather than an ad-hoc workflow.
